# FemtoRV (vendored subset)

Minimal RTL from [BrunoLevy/learn-fpga FemtoRV](https://github.com/BrunoLevy/learn-fpga/tree/master/FemtoRV):

- `RTL/PROCESSOR/femtorv32_quark_bicycle.v` — RV32I core
- `RTL/PROCESSOR/utils.v`
- `RTL/DEVICES/SDCard.v`, `Buttons.v`

Used by `src/loader_soc.v` for the SD card ROM menu. Academic / teaching license; see upstream repository.
